main_visual_task: At dusk the same sedan rests at a city overlook while the camera performs one continuous slow pullback from its glowing roofline out to a wide frame where the car's light bar answers the city lights.

matched_cut.in_state: same car and the same city skyline as S2 end, now parked at the overlook at dusk
matched_cut.out_state: static wide hero frame of the sedan facing the lit skyline, held for the end card

prompt_bible.subject_lock: the same one silver-grey electric concept sedan with a smooth closed front fascia, one thin full-width LED light bar, flush door handles, aerodynamic covered wheels, dark panoramic glass roof, badge-free body
prompt_bible.environment_lock: empty stone overlook above the city at dusk, low stone railing, city skyline with lit windows across the background, no people
prompt_bible.material_lock: brushed silver-grey paint under dusk light, dark glass roof reflecting city lights, stone railing, deep blue sky band
prompt_bible.lighting_lock: cool dusk ambient with warm city lights behind; the car's thin light bar glows warm-white as the single foreground key; light directions fixed
prompt_bible.palette_lock: silver grey, dusk blue, warm city-light amber, warm-white LED
prompt_bible.lens_texture: photoreal cinema lens, wide clean composition, gentle depth, natural highlight rolloff, no CGI geometry
prompt_bible.screen_direction: the car faces the skyline away from camera in three-quarter rear view; skyline stays level across the background
prompt_bible.audio_policy: soft evening air, distant city hum, faint electrical glow tone, no music, no voice

timeline.visual_state: the dark glass roof reflects the first city lights, the thin light bar glows warm-white below the rear view
timeline.subject_action: the parked car is perfectly still; reflections shimmer faintly in the glass
timeline.camera_action: begin one continuous very slow pull straight back from the roofline
timeline.focus: glass roof reflections and glowing light bar
timeline.lighting_state: cool dusk ambient with warm city lights behind
timeline.end_state: roof and light bar dominate frame

timeline.visual_state: the rear three-quarter of the car appears, light bar steady, stone railing edge enters low in frame
timeline.subject_action: stillness; the city lights behind grow slightly denser as dusk deepens
timeline.camera_action: continue the same straight pullback at unchanged slow speed
timeline.focus: rear three-quarter body and light bar

timeline.visual_state: the whole car stands on the overlook, skyline band spreading behind it
timeline.subject_action: absolute stillness; warm city windows answer the car's light bar
timeline.camera_action: continue only the same straight pullback, no orbit, no lateral move
timeline.lighting_state: dusk deepens, city lights fully on

timeline.visual_state: stone railing, empty overlook and the sedan facing the lit skyline
timeline.subject_action: nothing moves; light bar steady glow
timeline.camera_action: decelerate the same pullback gently toward a stop

timeline.visual_state: static hero frame: silver sedan, glowing light bar, lit skyline
timeline.camera_action: camera completes the pullback and stops dead
timeline.end_state: clean stable end-card frame, no motion

camera_plan.motivation: step back from the car to reveal that its single light line belongs to the larger constellation of the city
camera_plan.start_position: close on the reflective glass roof and glowing light bar
camera_plan.path: move straight backward along the optical axis, progressively revealing rear three-quarter, full car, railing and skyline, no lateral motion
camera_plan.speed_curve: one constant very slow backward move, decelerating to a full stop in the final second
camera_plan.focus_transition: roof reflections to light bar to full car to car-plus-skyline balance
camera_plan.end_position: wide static hero frame of the sedan facing the lit skyline over the stone railing
camera_plan.axis_lock: straight optical-axis pullback only; skyline stays level behind the car; no orbit, no lateral move
camera_plan.stop_condition: stop only when the wide end-card composition is still

first_frame: close view of the dark glass roof reflecting first city lights above the warm-white light bar at dusk
last_frame: wide static hero frame of the silver-grey electric sedan on a stone overlook facing the fully lit city skyline
